data.title: 空门苍 · 清晨榻榻米上的无防备诱惑
data.description: 山间偏房的和室里，宽大的男士衬衫扣子崩开了好几颗。苍趴在被褥上揉着睡眼惺忪的双眼，衬衫下摆堆积在大腿根部，半梦半醒间嘟囔着蹭了过来。

data.promptProse: In a quiet tatami guest room washed in morning sunlight, Ao lies across the tousled futon rubbing her half-open eyes with a drowsy expression. Soft beams from the sliding window warm the bedding and wooden floor.
data.animaCaption: Sprawled on her stomach across the morning futon, she rubs one sleepy eye as her oversized pale-blue shirt hangs unbuttoned off her shoulder and bunches high around her bare thighs in the sunlight.
data.nsfwProse: Several buttons of her oversized pale-blue men's shirt have come undone, exposing her bare shoulders, collarbones, and upper thighs with no bottoms visible beneath the rumpled hem.
